proof_body:
by
  intro K n _ _ _ _ A hA
  have h : A.transpose = -A := (LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.mem_so n K A).mp hA
  change Matrix.trace A = 0
  have h2 : Matrix.trace A = -Matrix.trace A := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Matrix.trace_transpose, h, Matrix.trace_neg]
  have h3 : (2 : K) * Matrix.trace A = 0 := by
    rw [two_mul]
    nth_rw 1 [h2]
    simp
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left (NeZero.ne 2)
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) (n : Type*) [Field K] [NeZero (2 : K)] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n], LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.so n K ≤ LieAlgebra.SpecialLinear.sl n K
